title: Understand the horizontal asymptote
text: For a hyperbola in the form y = a/(x - p) + q, the horizontal asymptote is y = q. This is the value y approaches as x becomes very large or very small.

title: Identify q in the equation
text: In g(x) = 3/(x - 2) + 1, the constant term added at the end is q = 1. Therefore, the horizontal asymptote is y = 1.
